study: Experiment 2 v2 - Anthropic-only extension (Apart AI x Epistemics sprint, Nov 13-15 2026)
reuses_frozen_protocol: v2_study/ at branch frozen/exp2-v2-protocol-v1 (commit bbc3901): same manifest (30 cases), prompts_v2.json, conditions, repetitions, parsers, outcomes and analysis code; imported read-only
settings_note: No temperature/top_p/top_k sent (API default, as in the pilot where no temperature was sent); no 'thinking' parameter (extended thinking off); no prompt caching; no tools; max_tokens 2000 (pilot value). Anthropic Messages API has no seed parameter, so conv_seed is NOT sent (recorded only as an identifier). The system prompt goes in the top-level 'system' field instead of a system-role message.

prices_verified.source: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/pricing (official Anthropic pricing page), fetched 2026-11-14 ~7:10 AM CT
prices_verified.unit: USD per token (list price, standard global endpoint, no batch, no caching)
prices_verified.notes: Opus 4.7 uses a newer tokenizer (~30% more tokens for the same text per the pricing page); cost is computed from the token counts the API returns, so this is captured. Batch API would be 50% cheaper but is not used (asynchronous; noted as an option).

credits.note: The Anthropic API exposes no endpoint for credit balance or promotional-credit eligibility. User-reported (Jack, Nov 14 2026, not verified): $100 Anthropic promotional credits expiring 2026-12-13, which Anthropic confirmed cover direct Claude API usage.

budget.cap_source: command line: run_anthropic.py --cap USD (kept out of the frozen config); proposed cap $50
